 At Indore

sentences.text:
Criminal Revision is admitted for hearing.
2.
Also heard on IA No.9918/2025 , application seeking suspension of execution of sentence passed against the petitioner Ashok Kumar.

3. This criminal revision has been filed against the judgment dated 30.06.2025 passed in criminal appeal no.13/2017 by the Court of Additional Judge to the Court of Additional Sessions Judge,
Jawad, District Neemuch (M.P.) whereby the appellate court has affirmed the conviction and sentence passed by the learned J.M.F.C., Jawad, District Neemcuh under section 120- B, 419 r/w 120B, 420 r/w 120B, 467 r/w 120B, 468 r/w 120B, 471 r/w 120B of the IPC and under Section 8 of the Registration Act, 1908 and sentenced for 02, 01, 02, 02, 02, 02 and 01 year RI and fine of Rs.
2,000/-, Rs. 2,000/-
, Rs.2,000/-, Rs. 2,000/-, Rs.2,000/-, Rs.2,000/- and Rs.1,000 respectively with default stipulations.
4.

entities.text:
Additional Sessions Judge,
Jawad, District Neemuch (M.P.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counsel for the petitioner submit that the petitioner is innocent and being falsely implicated in the case.
It is further submitted that the petitioner has surrendered before the trial Court on 01.09.2025.
The final hearing of this revision will likely to take long time, hence prays for suspension of 2 CRR-3165-2025 sentence and release of the petitioner on bail during this revision petition.
5. Counsel for the respondent/State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the arguments advanced by the counsel for the petitioner and the fact that the final hearing of this revision will likely to take time, the application is allowed and it is directed that the execution of sentence passed against the petitioner shall remain suspended and he be released on bail subject to his depositing fine amount, if not Ashok Kumar vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/39756357/
1 already deposited and furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand)
with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 19.12.2025 and on such further dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry during the pendency of this revision petition.
7. List in due course.
